tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj zdania (1.1.-1.8.). Wykorzystujac wyrazy podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij kazde zdanie z luka tak, aby precyzyjnie oddac sens zdania wyjsciowego. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna wpisywanych fragmentow zdan. Uwaga: nie zmieniaj formy podanych wyrazow. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac maksymalnie piec wyrazow, wliczajac w to wyraz juz podany. Formy skrocone (np. needn't, they're) sa liczone jako dwa wyrazy.

items.original: Although he was tired, he kept working.
If you do not hurry, you will miss the train.
However hard I tried, I could not open the jar.
items.transformed: _________ hard I tried, I could not open the jar.

items.original: I would only lend you the car if you drove carefully.
items.transformed: I would lend you the car _________ carefully.

items.original: He is rich but he is not happy.
Without your help, I would have failed.
items.transformed: If it _________ your help, I would have failed.

items.original: Take a map with you in case you get lost.
items.transformed: Take a map with you _________ getting lost.

items.original: Even if she apologises, I will not forgive her.
items.transformed: I will not forgive her _________ not.
